title: CreateBookingResponse
description: Response contract for POST /booking. Not used by /ping tests (text/plain); included for BookingTests extension.

bookingid.description: Unique identifier assigned by the server. Source: Restful Booker spec.

booking.description: Full booking payload echoed back by the server.

firstname.description: Guest first name. Source: Restful Booker spec.

lastname.description: Guest last name. Source: Restful Booker spec.

totalprice.description: Total booking price. Source: Restful Booker spec.

depositpaid.description: Whether the deposit has been paid. Source: Restful Booker spec.

bookingdates.description: Check-in / check-out date pair. Source: Restful Booker spec.

checkin.description: Check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD). Source: Restful Booker spec.

checkout.description: Check-out date (YYYY-MM-DD). Source: Restful Booker spec.

additionalneeds.description: Optional extra requirements (e.g. 'Breakfast'). Source: Restful Booker spec.
